name: HANDOFF.md
description: Cross-session continuity document written at a context boundary: current state, next steps, open questions, files in flight, last known-good commit, audit references. The resuming session verifies every gating assertion against live state before acting on it.

placeholders.name: task
placeholders.description: What the work is, in a few words.

placeholders.name: current_state
placeholders.description: What is in flight and what is committed. Facts a resuming session can verify.
placeholders.example: Schema written; eight atoms written; site pages not yet.

placeholders.name: next_steps
placeholders.description: Concrete actions for the resuming session, in order.
placeholders.example: 1. Add site pages. 2. Run the build.

placeholders.name: open_questions
placeholders.description: Decisions awaiting input, each with who can answer it.

placeholders.name: files_in_flight
placeholders.description: Paths being modified, with line ranges when helpful.

placeholders.name: audit_refs
placeholders.description: In-progress override or violation log entries, or 'none'.

example:
# HANDOFF — template class for ai-atoms

Last updated: 2026-09-03T20:10:00Z · Branch: feat/template-class

## Current state

Schema and eight template atoms written and validating. Site pages not started. Nothing committed on this branch yet.

## Next steps

1. Add listing and detail pages under web/src/pages/atoms/template/.
2. Run `python3 scripts/build-exports.py` and `python3 -m pytest`.
3. Commit in two pieces: schema+atoms, then site.

## Open questions

None.

## Files in flight

schemas/template-v1.json, atoms/template/*.json, web/src/lib/catalog.ts

## Last known-good commit

0b0be7d Second curation pass: descriptions, Cloudflare models, vendors, workflow removal (#53)

## Audit references

none
rules: No secrets in any section; write [REDACTED:<kind>] where one would otherwise appear.
On resume, verify every assertion that gates an action against live state before running it.
Write or update it whenever continuity is at risk, not only at the end.
